description: Schema for portal-managed multi-repo workspace sets. Closes #727 (shared workspace set model).

id.description: Stable workspace-set identifier (prefix ws- + 12 hex chars).

name.description: Human-readable display name for the workspace set.

description.description: Optional description of the workspace set purpose.

repos.description: Ordered list of repository identities in this workspace set.

canonical_path.description: Canonical absolute path to the repository root.

remote_url.description: Git remote origin URL (used for cross-machine identity matching).

repo_id.description: Optional stable repo ID from a central registry.

launch_order.description: Order in which this repo should be opened during workspace launch (0 = first / primary).

type.description: Whether the owner is an individual user or a team.

scope.description: Sharing scope of the workspace set.

rbac.description: RBAC controls for team/org-shared workspace sets.

viewers.description: List of user or team identifiers who can view and launch this set.

editors.description: List of user or team identifiers who can edit this set.

approval_required.description: Whether launching this set requires approval (Appsmith workflow).

approved_by.description: Identifier of the approver who last approved access to this set.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace set was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the workspace set was last updated.

launched_count.description: Number of times this workspace set has been launched.

policy_compliant.description: Whether this workspace set passed last policy conformance check.

policy_checked_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last policy conformance check.
